children: Expand Energy entered into an Underwriting Agreement to issue $500 million of 5.650% Senior Notes due 2031, raising long-term capital. Citigroup Global Markets and J.P. Morgan Securities are acting as representatives of the underwriters. The offering is registered with the SEC and is expected to close on September 17, 2026, subject to customary conditions. The agreement includes customary indemnification and contribution provisions.
